rules.note: Recent photo taken no more than two years before you submit.
Data page of your passport showing your personal data and photo. If you have no passport, upload your national ID card.
School certificate for your level, with a translation if it is not in the programme language or Hungarian. If you are still studying, upload your final degree by 1 August.
Secondary school graduation certificate or equivalent, with a translation if it is not in the programme language or Hungarian.
Bachelor's degree certificate or equivalent, with a translation if it is not in the programme language or Hungarian. If you are still studying, upload the final degree by 1 August.
Secondary school graduation certificate, with a translation if it is not in the programme language or Hungarian.
Transcript of records covering all semesters or years of your highest completed study, with a translation if needed.
Motivation letter of at least one page, Times New Roman 12 pt, in the programme language or Hungarian.
Proof of language level required by the host institution, as a scan. If your earlier studies were in the programme language, upload proof of that instead. Add a translation if needed.
Research plan of at least 2 pages, Times New Roman 12 pt, in the programme language, listing your sources. Universities check it for plagiarism.
Signed letter from a former or current academic tutor or supervisor with a scientific degree who knows your work, in the programme language or Hungarian.
Statement of a supervisor at the host institution agreeing to supervise you. Needed only if the doctoral school asks for it, and it may be sent after the deadline.
Do not upload it now. Only scholarship recipients need a medical certificate on the official template, which you bring to Hungary for the medical exam.
